chars.SAID: SAID: a slim young man wearing a red hooded tracksuit jacket with white stripes on the sleeves, black jogging pants and white sneakers.
chars.FRIEND: FRIEND: a stocky young man wearing a green bomber jacket, blue jeans and a black beanie.
chars.HAJ: HAJ: a big broad-shouldered old farmer wearing a brown wool Moroccan djellaba with the hood down and a white skullcap, holding a thick wooden club.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Night at a farm in the Moroccan countryside. SAID sneaks crouching toward a cow barn full of cows, looking around nervously, while behind him, half hidden in the shadow of the barn door, HAJ watches him angrily gripping his wooden club. Moonlight, tense atmosphere.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Night inside a moonlit Moroccan farm yard with many cows and a few sheep behind a wooden fence. SAID and FRIEND crouch behind a hay pile whispering and pointing at the cows, planning how to get them out. Sneaky, nervous expressions.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Night, wide Moroccan farm field with a barn. SAID stands near the barn in the foreground, FRIEND is far away in the background near an old pickup truck by a dirt road. The distance between them is big. SAID looks worried.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Night at the farm. SAID waves his hand toward the distance calling his friend, not seeing HAJ who comes from behind and swings his wooden club down at SAID's head. Dramatic motion lines, shock.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Night at the farm. SAID lies dazed on the dirt ground holding his head, while HAJ stands over him furious, raising the wooden club with both hands. Cows in the background.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Night, dirt road next to a Moroccan farm. FRIEND runs away in panic toward an old pickup truck, looking back over his shoulder with fear, abandoning his friend. Dust behind his feet.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Early morning at a Moroccan farm. SAID sits tied with thick ropes to the trunk of a big olive tree, bruised and scared, shouting for help. Barn and cows in the background.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Morning at a Moroccan farm. SAID is tied to an olive tree, HAJ stands in front of him pointing angrily at him, accusing him of being the thief who stole from him many times. SAID shakes his head in fear.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: Daytime at an isolated Moroccan farm with empty fields all around, no one else in sight. HAJ walks toward SAID who is tied to the olive tree, slapping the wooden club in his palm menacingly. SAID looks terrified and hopeless.
